text: Service DIAG = data and AI diagnostic of a client company (audit of data, processes and quick wins).
Service TRAIN = AI training for client staff (workshops for employees or managers).
Service LEAN = process mapping and value-stream mapping of a workshop or office flow.
Service PROTO = a working prototype (agent, dashboard, automation) built for the client.
Service BID = help to answer a public tender or call for proposals.
Default deliverable: DIAG -> report, TRAIN -> workshop, LEAN -> map, PROTO -> prototype, BID -> proposal.
Days for DIAG: 3 days, plus 1 day if the client has more than 50 employees.
Days for TRAIN: 1 day per group of up to 10 attendees (e.g. 25 attendees = 3 days).
Days for LEAN: 2 days per site to map.
Days for PROTO: 5 days, or 8 days if the prototype must connect to the client's ERP.
Days for BID: 2 days whatever the tender.
Answer format: {"service": "DIAG|TRAIN|LEAN|PROTO|BID", "deliverable": "...", "days": N} and nothing else.
